scope: Primary-source audit of RESEARCH_LOG.md sections 7-8 and 13-14, plus PROGRAM_ALPHA.md's constant ledger

sources.title: Improving R(3,k) in just two bites
sources.primary_claim_checked: R(3,k) >= (1/2+o(1)) k^2/log k; best known upper bound is (1+o(1)) k^2/log k; 1/2 is conjectured asymptotically tight by multiple groups.
sources.qualification: This proves a lower asymptotic coefficient, not existence of a limiting constant c_R.

sources.title: On the Erdos-Rogers function
sources.primary_claim_checked: For every fixed s>=2, f_{s,s+1}(n)=Theta(sqrt(n log n)); the construction gives a K_{s+1}-free graph in which every C(s)sqrt(n log n)-set contains K_s.
sources.qualification: The paper itself invokes JMRS for the lower bound. Its simpler displayed construction has polynomial dependence on s; the refined discussion gives C(s)=O(s^(3/2)sqrt(log s)).

sources.title: Tight Bounds on the Clique Chromatic Number
sources.primary_claim_checked: For every epsilon>0 and sufficiently large Delta, chi_c(G)<=(1+epsilon)Delta/log Delta; every n-vertex graph has chi_c=O(sqrt(n/log n)).
sources.qualification: The paper's word 'tight' is order-of-magnitude tightness via triangle-free graphs. It does not establish that leading coefficient 1 is attained or optimal.

sources.title: A note on the clique-transversal number
sources.identifier: Public PDF with no author/version metadata visible
sources.primary_claim_checked: It explicitly derives T(n)=n-Theta(sqrt(n log n)) from JMRS and triangle-free Ramsey graphs, and explicitly says the stronger Erdos-Gallai-Tuza speculation tau(G)<=n-f(n) remains open.
sources.qualification: Its bibliographic status is weak, but it predates this campaign and defeats any priority claim for the order-of-magnitude R1 connection.

sources.title: On Small Folkman Graphs Arrowing K2 or K3
sources.primary_claim_checked: Defines F_e by K4-free edge-arrowing witnesses and records current bounds 21 <= F_e(3,3;4) <= 786.
sources.qualification: The Fable log's [20,786] range is stale; the logical implication from a 50-vertex K4-free arrowing witness to F_e<=50 remains valid.

queries: exact web searches for the EGT inequality and clique chromatic number
absence_search.finding: The three cited ingredient papers do not mention the stronger EGT conjecture, but ULAM_NOTE26 does. Absence from the three ingredient papers is therefore not evidence of novelty.
